tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH counts AS (
  SELECT pt.TrackId, t.Name, COUNT(pt.PlaylistId) AS playlist_count
  FROM PlaylistTrack pt
  JOIN Track t USING(TrackId)
  GROUP BY pt.TrackId
)
SELECT playlist_count, TrackId, Name
FROM counts
WHERE playlist_count = (SELECT MAX(playlist_count) FROM counts)
ORDER BY TrackId;"}
